raw_response:
Ai, let me think about this year. I'm getting old now, 60 already, been farming this land since I was a boy. Nine mu isn't much but it feeds us. My wife helps, and my son comes back for busy times — harvest, planting. The girl is married off already.

My main land, about 5 mu of it, that's the good flat ground, I do wheat then maize same as everybody. Been doing it this way forever. You plant wheat in October after the maize comes off, then next June when wheat is cut, you turn right around and put maize in — no time to rest, the ground has to work.

Then I got 2 mu on the side where I still do cotton. My neighbors mostly quit cotton, too much work picking, but I know cotton, my hands know it. Price is okay when it's okay. My wife helps pick.

The other 2 mu I keep for watermelon. That's my cash. When watermelon is good, one season pays more than the wheat and maize together. When it's bad, well, at least the grain is in the shed.

**Wheat (5 mu):** I plant around October 10th, same time as everyone in the village. I use the seed I bought from the agri-station last year — the variety my neighbor Old Wang uses, he gets good yield. Before planting I put down about 2 bags of compound fertilizer per mu — that's maybe 40 kg of the 15-15-15 stuff. Then around March when it starts greening up, I topdress with urea, maybe half a bag per mu. If it looks yellow I add a bit more. I water it 3 times — before winter, at jointing, and at filling. The well is close so water isn't too bad, but the electric bill adds up. I spray once for weeds in spring. Last year I got about 400 kg per mu, hoping for similar.

**Maize (5 mu):** Right after wheat harvest in June, same day or next day if I can. No time to plow properly — I do rotary tillage, quick and in. I use hybrid seed, whatever the shop has that the others are buying. Put a bag and a half of compound at planting, about 30 kg per mu. Then when it's waist-high I put down urea, maybe 15 kg per mu. I only irrigate if it doesn't rain — usually summer has rain so maybe one time, maybe none. Spray once for corn borer if I see them. Target about 450 kg per mu.

**Cotton (2 mu):** Plant end of April when soil is warm. I save some seed but also buy fresh. Cotton eats fertilizer — I put 2 bags compound at planting and topdress urea twice, once at flowering, once at bolling. Maybe 15 kg N per mu total. I irrigate 2 times usually. Pests are the headache — I spray several times through the season, whatever the shop recommends. Picking is my wife and me, sometimes hire a neighbor lady for a few days. Last year maybe 220 kg lint per mu.

**Watermelon (2 mu):** This is the gamble. Plant seedlings end of April. I use more fertilizer here than anything else — watermelon needs it. Manure from the village if I can get it, plus compound fertilizer. Drip tape if I can afford it this year, otherwise furrow water. Lots of work — training vines, watching for disease. If the price holds I could get good money, if the market floods, I sell cheap at the roadside.
